question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**rain**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us that Kala Nag's pit was flooded by the rain.
 
• The monsoons caused heavy rainfall, which led to flooding, making **"rain" **(बारिश) the appropriate subject in the sentence.
 
• Other options ("**clouds**", "**snow**", "**heat**") do not fit the context as effectively as "**rain**".

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *One day we saw Kala Nag. The monsoons had burst with all their fury, and it had rained in the night. The earth, which had lain parched and dry under the withering heat of the summer sun, was teeming with __life. In little pools, frogs croaked. The muddy ground was littered with __crawling __worms, centipedes and velvety lady-birds. Grass __had __begun to show and the banana leaves glistened bright and glossy green. The __**rain **__had flooded Kala Nag's hole. He sat in an open patch on the lawn. His shiny black hood glistened in the sunlight. He was big, almost six feet in 5______ and rounded and fleshy, as my wrist. "Looks like a King Cobra. Let's get him."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Clouds (बादल):** "Clouds" refer to visible masses of condensed water vapor.
 
• **Snow (बर्फ़):** "Snow" means precipitation in the form of ice crystals.
 
• **Heat (गर्मी): **"Heat" means high temperature.
